name: Cinacalcet
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Starting or stopping one may require a cinacalcet dose change; monitor iPTH, serum calcium and phosphorus closely.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: CYP2D6 substrates (metoprolol, carvedilol, desipramine); narrow-margin ones (flecainide, most tricyclic antidepressants)
key_interactions.effect: Cinacalcet is a strong CYP2D6 inhibitor and raises their levels (label).
key_interactions.action: Dose adjustment of the CYP2D6 substrate may be required, especially narrow-margin drugs.
